objective: Ensure the formal native-4K build chain actually applies and fail-closed validates the existing high-detail woody-continuity correction after generated tree regeneration, so corrected trunk/branch taper and metric bark UVs are not merely optional editor-side work.

priorityReasoning.observedGap: QualityBlock4KCapture enters QualityBlockGroundDetailUpgrade.BuildDetailedGround, which enters QualityBlockFoliageOpticsUpgrade.BuildFoliageOptics. That foliage build regenerated detailed tree masters but did not invoke QualityBlockTreeWoodyContinuityQA before morphology/optical processing. Formal capture also relied on foliage validation rather than directly calling the woody validator.
priorityReasoning.visualRisk: A formally rebuilt candidate could therefore proceed with the pre-correction segmented woody geometry/UV state, increasing modular trunk/branch reads and bark-phase repetition risk in native-4K vegetation framing.
priorityReasoning.scorePriority: This directly affects Geometry & construction fidelity, Vegetation/natural complexity and Texture/microdetail, with secondary Material/PBR and LOD stability implications. No rendered points are awarded by this source fix.

changes.summary: Inserted QualityBlockTreeWoodyContinuityQA.ApplyToOpenScene immediately after BuildDetailedTrees + benchmark-scene reopen and before morphology/foliage optics. Updated the build log to state that continuous woody geometry is part of the built candidate while render inspection remains pending.

Made foliage validation transitively invoke QualityBlockTreeWoodyContinuityQA.ValidateOpenScene, causing the formal capture chain to fail closed if woody taper/UV/LOD/material continuity is absent or drifted.

Added machine-readable formal-build ordering, generated-tree construction/material/UV/LOD requirements, fail-closed rules and actual-render evidence requirements. Automatic Visual Fidelity credit remains zero.
